# Travelaxis

> Professional visa documentation consultancy, UAE company formation, business setup in Dubai, trade licensing, and related government services. Serves Pakistani nationals with UAE document attestation and visa documentation for the UK, Canada, Australia, and the USA, alongside UAE-focused services. Based in Al Qusais, Dubai, UAE. Content is general information, not legal advice. Travelaxis is a documentation and consultancy service — it does not issue visas or licenses, arrange sponsorship or jobs, guarantee approval, or provide regulated immigration/legal consulting (e.g. Canada Express Entry/PNP, Australia skilled-visa assessment, US H-1B petition filing or family-based immigrant visas); applications are submitted through the relevant country's official government channels.

- [Australia visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/australia-visa-from-pakistan/) — Visitor, Student, and Partner/Family visa documentation (not skilled-visa points assessment, which requires a MARA-registered agent)

- [UAE Job-Seeker Visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/job-seeker-visa-from-pakistan/) — eligibility tiers, documents, the IBCC/HEC → MOFA → UAE Embassy → MOFAIC attestation chain

- [Dubai Work Visa Price from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/dubai-work-visa-price-from-pakistan/) — full cost breakdown, who legally pays for what, overcharging red flags
- [UAE Student Visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/blog/uae-student-visa-from-pakistan/) — university sponsorship, IBCC/HEC attestation, O/A-level equivalency
